metadata.rationale_basis: docs/cross-phase/standards/wg_decision_pattern_comparison.md (per-WG decision-form patterns) + Phase-2 Final Report parsing logs (figure/chart/summary/sessionnotes incidence per WG) + 3GPP RAN charter scope (RAN5 = mobile terminal conformance testing).

absence_reasons.Chart: Native OpenXML chart objects (<c:chart>) embedded in DOCX Final Reports are rare by 3GPP authoring convention; no instances were extracted from the released RAN2 Final Report corpus.
absence_reasons.Figure: RAN2 Final Reports center on protocol decisions and rarely include raster figures in the chairman-note body; the released RAN2 snapshot extracted no Figure instances. Schema is unchanged; future ingestion can populate.
absence_reasons.SessionNotes: RAN2 chairman notes do not separate per-session annotations as a distinct artifact; session-level information is folded into Agreement/Conclusion entries.
absence_reasons.Summary: RAN2 does not customarily produce a 'Summary' Tdoc subtype as a standalone document class; agenda-item-level summaries appear inside Final Reports rather than as separate TDocs.

absence_reasons.Chart: Same as RAN2: native OpenXML chart objects are uncommon in 3GPP DOCX authoring; none extracted from the released RAN3 corpus.
absence_reasons.Figure: RAN3 Final Reports are decision-text dominant (NG-RAN architecture descriptions) and do not embed figures in the released snapshot.
absence_reasons.SessionNotes: RAN3 chairman notes use the 'Decision: ...' TDoc-level format rather than per-session annotation blocks (see docs/cross-phase/standards/wg_decision_pattern_comparison.md).

RAN4 chairman notes use the 'Decision: ...' TDoc-level format predominantly (see wg_decision_pattern_comparison.md: 982-1192 Decision lines per meeting vs 0 Agreement headers); per-session annotation is not maintained as a separate artifact in the RAN4 release scope.
absence_reasons.Summary: Like RAN2, RAN4 does not customarily produce a standalone Summary TDoc subtype; agenda-item summaries are absorbed into the chairman-note body.

absence_reasons.Agreement: RAN5 is the mobile-terminal-conformance-testing WG: decisions are dominated by per-TDoc 'Decision: agreed/revised' lines (~50% of TDocs marked agreed; 30,950 of 62,069) rather than meeting-level Agreement headers. Only 83 Resolution-headed entries appear across all RAN5 meetings, all classified as Conclusion. The released snapshot therefore instantiates Conclusion but no Agreement nodes; the schema admits Agreement and instantiation will follow if/when RAN5 chairman-note format converges with RAN1/2.
absence_reasons.Chart: Same as RAN2/RAN3: native OpenXML chart embedding is rare; no instances extracted.
absence_reasons.Figure: RAN5 Final Reports are conformance-test-table heavy (Table is numerous) but seldom embed raster figures; the released snapshot extracted no Figure instances.
absence_reasons.SessionNotes: Same TDoc-level decision pattern as RAN3/RAN4 - chairman notes use 'Decision: ...' lines rather than per-session annotation blocks.
absence_reasons.Summary: Same as RAN2/RAN4: no standalone Summary TDoc subtype is produced; conformance test summaries appear inside the body of CR/TR documents.
absence_reasons.WorkingAssumption: Conformance testing decisions are typically firm pass/fail outcomes rather than provisional assumptions awaiting later confirmation; the chairman-note format does not use the 'Working Assumption' phrasing characteristic of RAN1/2 design discussions.

interpretation_notes: All absences reflect released-snapshot and loader scope, not schema gaps. Each absent class is defined in spectra.ttl and can be populated by future ingestion if/when the source documents change.
An OWL diff of kg/per_wg_schema/RAN{1..5}-schema.ttl against ontology/spectra.ttl reproduces the per-WG presence/absence pattern recorded above.

The decision-pattern context (Agreement headers vs TDoc-level 'Decision:' lines) is documented in docs/cross-phase/standards/wg_decision_pattern_comparison.md (in the dev tree; not redistributed in the public release_package, but the per-WG counts above suffice to reproduce the conclusion).

RAN5 conformance-testing scope is the structural reason five of its six absent classes (Agreement, Chart, Figure, Summary, WorkingAssumption) differ from the RAN1 design-WG profile; SessionNotes is absent across RAN3/4/5 by a separate authoring convention shared with the chairman-note format used in those WGs.
